issues.description: The solution's set_pixel uses 3 bytes per pixel (it multiplies x by 3: mov edx, 3; mul edx) while the problem statement explicitly explains pixels are rounded up to 32 bits (4 bytes) and the main routine in the solution computes offsets using 4 bytes per pixel (mul by 4). This mismatch (3 vs 4 bytes per pixel) leads to incorrect address calculation in set_pixel and inconsistent behavior between main and set_pixel.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the pixel byte-size consistent: adjust set_pixel to compute x*4 (or otherwise use 4 bytes per pixel, e.g. shift left by 2) so the address calculation matches the 32-bit-per-pixel description and the main routine. Also update any misleading comments (e.g. changed 'x*3' comment) to reflect 4 bytes per pixel.
